card.name: Inside split-up compound terms
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of a long drug name, unit word, or slash-joined pair, where the word is split into odd chunks (e.g. Per|am|panel, milli|meter, timolol after a slash).

modes.label: Drug names split up
modes.description: A middle chunk of a long drug name or a combined drug pair joined by a slash.

modes.label: Unit words split up
modes.description: The 'ill' chunk inside milligram or millimeter.

modes.label: Slash-joined list items
modes.description: A slash or short chunk joining two medical terms such as arrest/asystole.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of long words that get cut into pieces, like drug names and milli- units.
